source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5 ("Rural councils: results of polling")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Two contests, Ballymaconaghy and Holywood Rural (Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5; Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1). Unopposed returns: Ballyhackamore (William Geary; the sitting member withdrew) and Castlereagh (John Johnston); no nomination for Craigavad, whose retiring member Thomas Gray was deemed re-elected (Northern Whig and Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1958). The Whig says the six other retiring members were returned unopposed; four of them (Ballycultra, Ballymiscaw, Dundonald, Gilnahirk) are not named in the sources searched (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Ryan was the outgoing vice-chairman.
